title: Lab - Git and SSL certificates
description: Generate a certificate and keep the config in Git.
scenario: Generate a certificate and keep the config in Git. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Key and CSR
tasks.instructions: Generate a 2048-bit RSA key and a CSR for CN=lab.local.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Self-sign
tasks.instructions: Self-sign it for 365 days and read the expiry.
tasks.solution:
openssl x509 -req -in lab.csr -signkey lab.key -days 365 -out lab.crt
openssl x509 -in lab.crt -noout -dates

tasks.title: Task 3 - Git
tasks.instructions: Initialise a repo in /opt/lab, commit the .conf files on a branch called config, and show the log.
tasks.solution: cd /opt/lab && git init && git checkout -b config && git add "*.conf" && git commit -m "config"
